title: DeploymentConfig 基础
description: 定义 2 副本的 DeploymentConfig
full_code:
apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1
kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:
  name: myapp
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    app: myapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: myapp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: myapp
        image: myapp:latest

points.hint: 补充「标签 app 的值」

spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1

  selector:
    app: myapp
  template:

title: BuildConfig 源码构建
description: 定义从 Git 构建 Source 镜像
full_code:
apiVersion: build.openshift.io/v1
kind: BuildConfig
metadata:
  name: demo
spec:
  source:
    type: Git
    git:
      uri: "https://github.com/example/demo.git"
  strategy:
    type: Source
  output:
    to:
      kind: ImageStreamTag
      name: demo:latest

spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: build.openshift.io/v1
kind: BuildConfig

  name: demo
spec:
  source:
    type: Git
    git:
      uri: "https://github.com/example/demo.git"
  strategy:
    type: Source
  output:
    to:
      kind: ImageStreamTag
      name: demo:latest

explanation: BuildConfig 从 Git 拉取源码并构建；Source strategy 产出自定义镜像。

title: Route 配置 TLS

    kind: Service
    name: secure-app
  tls:
    termination: edge
    insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy: Redirect

spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: route.openshift.io/v1

    name: secure-app

title: DeploymentConfig 触发器
description: 配置镜像变更自动部署
full_code:
apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1
kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:
  name: myapp
spec:
  replicas: 2
  triggers:
  - type: ConfigChange
  - type: ImageChange
    imageChangeParams:
      automatic: true
      containerNames:
      - myapp
      from:
        kind: ImageStreamTag
        name: myapp:latest
  selector:
    app: myapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: myapp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: myapp
        image: myapp:latest

points.hint: 补充「标签 app 的值」

spotter_hints.level_4:

kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:

spec:

title: 存活探针
description: 给 DC 容器配 liveness 探针
full_code:
apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1
kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get packagemanifest

explanation: PackageManifest 来自 OperatorHub，列出可订阅安装的 Operator。

title: Route 与 Ingress
description: 用 oc 查看 Route（对应 K8s Ingress）

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get routes

explanation: Route 是 OCP 对 Ingress 的增强：自带 TLS 终止、权重路由等。

title: SecurityContextConstraints
description: 查看 SCC（安全上下文约束）

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get scc

explanation: SCC 取代了废弃的 PodSecurityPolicy，控制 Pod 能以什么身份运行。

title: ImageStream
description: 查看镜像流

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get is

explanation: ImageStream 是 OCP 的镜像抽象（K8s 无），连接构建与部署的镜像来源。

title: BuildConfig
description: 查看构建配置

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get bc

explanation: BuildConfig 定义从源码构建镜像的流程，K8s 本身没有内置构建能力。

title: 集群升级
description: 用 oc adm 触发集群升级

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc adm upgrade

explanation: `oc adm upgrade` 管理 OCP 集群升级（K8s 用 kubeadm/托管平台）。

title: 批准 CSR
description: 批准待处理的证书请求

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc adm certificate approve node-abc

explanation: 节点加入集群时需 `oc adm certificate approve` 批准其 CSR（K8s 用 kubectl）。

title: 节点维护
description: 用 oc adm 驱逐节点 Pod

spotter_hints.level_1: 💡 驱逐节点 Pod 的命令
spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc adm drain node-1 --ignore-daemonsets

explanation: `oc adm drain` 与 kubectl 类似，是 OCP 的管理员级节点维护入口。

title: 查看用户
description: 查看集群用户

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get users

explanation: OCP 用 OAuth/身份提供方管理用户，`oc get users` 是 K8s 没有的用户对象。

title: 系统项目
description: 查看项目（对应命名空间）

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get projects

explanation: Project 是 OCP 对 Namespace 的封装，自带配额与访问控制，还有 openshift-* 系统项目。

title: 模板
description: 查看模板（OCP 版 Helm）

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get templates

explanation: Template 是 OCP 的参数化资源模板，早于 Helm；Helm 也受支持。

title: 查看 Operator 列表
description: 查看已安装的 Operator

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get operators

explanation: OCP 自带 OLM，`oc get operators` 列出集群中安装的 Operator。

title: 集群网络配置

spotter_hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：正确答案：oc get network cluster

explanation: `oc get network cluster` 查看 OVN-Kubernetes/OpenShiftSDN 等网络插件配置。

title: Route 边缘 TLS
description: 用 edge 终止的 Route（对比 Ingress TLS）
full_code:
apiVersion: route.openshift.io/v1
kind: Route
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  to:
    kind: Service
    name: web
  tls:
    termination: edge
    insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy: Redirect

spotter_hints.level_3: 👀 Route 的 TLS 在 spec.tls 配置，edge 在路由层终止
spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: route.openshift.io/v1
kind: Route
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  to:
    kind: Service
    name: web
  tls:
    termination: edge
    insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy: Redirect

explanation: Route 原生支持 edge/passthrough/reencrypt 三种 TLS，比 K8s Ingress 更直接。

title: DeploymentConfig 定义
description: 用 DC 定义应用（对比 Deployment）
full_code:
apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1
kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: web:latest

points.hint: 补充「标签 app 的值」

spotter_hints.level_3: 👀 DC 用 apps.openshift.io/v1，Deployment 用 apps/v1
spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1
kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: web:latest

explanation: 两者都管副本，但 DC 额外支持触发器与自动回滚，是 OCP 的增强部署对象。

title: 镜像变更触发器
description: DC 在镜像更新时自动部署
full_code:
apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1
kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 1
  triggers:
  - type: ImageChange
    imageChangeParams:
      automatic: true
      containerNames:
      - web
      from:
        kind: ImageStreamTag
        name: web:latest
  selector:
    app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: web:latest

points.hint: 补充「标签 app 的值」

spotter_hints.level_3: 👀 镜像更新自动触发滚动部署，Deployment 需手动改 image
spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: apps.openshift.io/v1
kind: DeploymentConfig
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 1
  triggers:
  - type: ImageChange
    imageChangeParams:
      automatic: true
      containerNames:
      - web
      from:
        kind: ImageStreamTag
        name: web:latest
  selector:
    app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: web:latest

explanation: DC 的 ImageChange 触发器在 ImageStream 更新时自动部署，K8s Deployment 需额外手段。

title: 构建输出镜像流
description: BuildConfig 输出到 ImageStreamTag
full_code:
apiVersion: build.openshift.io/v1
kind: BuildConfig
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  source:
    type: Git
    git:
      uri: "https://github.com/example/web.git"
  strategy:
    type: Source
  output:
    to:
      kind: ImageStreamTag
      name: web:latest

points.hint: 构建产物写入的镜像流标签

spotter_hints.level_3: 👀 OCP 源码构建输出到 ImageStreamTag
spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: build.openshift.io/v1
kind: BuildConfig
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  source:
    type: Git
    git:
      uri: "https://github.com/example/web.git"
  strategy:
    type: Source
  output:
    to:
      kind: ImageStreamTag
      name: web:latest

explanation: OCP 内置 Source-to-Image 构建流水线，构建产物写入 ImageStreamTag 供部署。

title: MachineConfig 配置
description: 给节点注入内核参数
full_code:
apiVersion: machineconfiguration.openshift.io/v1
kind: MachineConfig
metadata:
  name: 99-worker-sysctl
  labels:
    machineconfiguration.openshift.io/role: worker
spec:
  config:
    ignition:
      version: 3.2.0
    storage:
      files:
      - path: /etc/sysctl.d/99-fs.conf
        contents:
          source: data:,%20fs.file-max%20%3D%2050000

spotter_hints.level_3: 👀 用 ignition 配置节点，K8s 无此对象
spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: machineconfiguration.openshift.io/v1
kind: MachineConfig
metadata:
  name: 99-worker-sysctl
  labels:
    machineconfiguration.openshift.io/role: worker
spec:
  config:
    ignition:
      version: 3.2.0
    storage:
      files:
      - path: /etc/sysctl.d/99-fs.conf
        contents:
          source: data:,%20fs.file-max%20%3D%2050000

explanation: MachineConfig 用 Ignition 给 RHCOS 节点下发系统级配置，这是 OCP 节点管理核心。

title: SCC 安全约束
description: 允许特权容器
full_code:
apiVersion: security.openshift.io/v1
kind: SecurityContextConstraints
metadata:
  name: privileged
allowPrivilegedContainer: true
allowedCapabilities:
- "*"
runAsUser:
  type: RunAsAny

spotter_hints.level_3: 👀 SCC 用 security.openshift.io/v1，取代废弃的 PSP
spotter_hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：正确答案：apiVersion: security.openshift.io/v1
kind: SecurityContextConstraints
metadata:
  name: privileged
allowPrivilegedContainer: true
allowedCapabilities:
- "*"
runAsUser:
  type: RunAsAny

explanation: SCC 决定 Pod 能否以特权/root 运行，是 OCP 的安全扩展（K8s 已弃用 PSP）。
